overall: The AG found the Board's 2010 and 2011 open session minutes omitted votes and actions shown in the recording secretary's notes, and ordered the Board to amend and approve them within 30 days; the matter was closed by informal action.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board's Dec. 6, 2010 and July 18, 2011 open session minutes were inaccurate because they omitted votes and motions made at those meetings.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Board's December 6, 2010 and July 18, 2011 meeting minutes failed to contain an accurate summary of the discussion that occurred.

remedy: Within thirty (30) days of receipt of the letter, review, amend, and approve the final minutes of the December 6, 2010 and July 18, 2011 meetings to include the missing information, and certify compliance to the AG in writing.
remedy_passage: We therefore order the Board to review, amend, and approve the final minutes of its December 6, 2010 and July 18, 2011 meetings to include the missing information highlighted in the complaint.
